prompts.name: dl_wide
prompts.prompt: Outpainting task only. The sharp horizontal photo band in the middle of this image is a real news photo: keep it exactly unchanged pixel for pixel (the bald man in a grey suit, his face, the room, everything). Replace only the blurry areas above and below with a natural, seamless continuation of the same room: the wall and ceiling above, and the man's suit body and the room floor below, matching the lighting, perspective and camera grain. Same framing, 4:5 vertical. Do not change the man's face or add anything new. No text, no letters, no logos.
